$comment: DRAFT v0.1. Owner: Saga. Rules per docs/loners-spec.md v0.4. Story data only; trait levels in narrativeLeaning are suggestions for Tundra. bandAffinity is a narrative leaning toward other loners (likely|possible|unlikely), not mutual affinity numbers; empty for cats who cannot band (females, elders).

loners.name: Greymantle
loners.appearance: Heavy grey tom gone white at the muzzle, one saber worn blunt, a deep old scar across both forelegs.

departure.reason: Unjustly blamed by Ashmane for a cub's fall from the high ledge, to protect her son Stonebrow.

loners.attitudeToOrigin: Loves the crag, hates what its leader did. Would never harm a Highcrag cat.
loners.range: The Split Rock and the lower slope of the Ice Wall, within sight of the crag.
loners.secret: Knows Stonebrow let the cub fall and that Ashmane knows. Years ago he carried Nettle's rescued Bonefield cub (Thistle) into Highcrag.
loners.sampleLine: They have taken my name out of the song. The stones still remember it.
loners.narrativeLeaning: Slow but steady to win over; respects courtesy and patience. Not a rival (aggression: low). Elder, so not band-eligible.

loners.name: Sorrel
loners.appearance: Lean red-gold queen with dark ticked stripes along her back, pale amber eyes, sabers still a little short for her face.

departure.reason: Forbidden mate: Highcrag custom refused her bond with Redthroat of Bonefield, so she left to meet him. He has not come.

loners.attitudeToOrigin: Homesick and angry in turns. Misses her mother and the caves, not the law.
loners.range: Greywater Ford and the Split Rock.
loners.secret: Redthroat's silence has a reason she doesn't know; Scarjaw may have forbidden him, or worse.
loners.sampleLine: I'm not waiting for him. I just happen to like this rock.
loners.narrativeLeaning: Easy to win over (sociability: high). Never a rival (aggression: low). Natural courtship candidate.

loners.name: Torncheek
loners.appearance: Massive dun tom with a snapped left saber, thick scarred forelimbs, and pale yellow eyes that rarely blink.

departure.reason: Failed challenge: lost a leadership challenge to Scarjaw, and Bonefield law drives the loser out.

loners.attitudeToOrigin: Loves the pride, hates its leader, means to take it back.
loners.range: The Tar Seeps and the Bear's Throat, just outside Bonefield land.
loners.secret: Counts the seasons until Scarjaw weakens. Would use any ally, the player included, to get close to Bonefield again.
loners.sampleLine: One tooth is enough. Ask Scarjaw how many he has left by spring.
loners.narrativeLeaning: Hard to win over; respects only strength. Likely rival (aggression: high, sociability: low). Most likely band founder.

loners.name: Nettle
loners.appearance: Dark brindle queen with a torn right ear, a white blaze on her chest, and long clean sabers.

departure.reason: Disagreement: ordered to bring Tallgrass's cubs to Scarjaw to be killed, she saved one in secret and left the next season.

loners.attitudeToOrigin: Grief and disgust, but she still has friends there and would not see them hurt.
loners.range: The Bear's Throat and the Split Rock.
loners.secret: The cub she saved lived: Thistle, now a young Highcrag cat and Tallgrass's son, with a blood claim to Bonefield.
loners.sampleLine: I've killed for that pride. I won't kill cubs for it.
loners.narrativeLeaning: Guarded, then very loyal once trust is earned. Fierce (aggression: high, sociability: medium) but a rival only if the player turns her against them. Kindness to cubs wins her fastest.

loners.name: Duskrunner
loners.appearance: Long-legged tawny tom with faint dusk-grey spots, a nicked bobtail, and bright green eyes.

departure.reason: Wanderlust: never liked the training fights, and after his half-brother's exile he walked north to see past the Ice Wall.

loners.attitudeToOrigin: No hatred, no longing. Too loud.
loners.range: The foot of the Ice Wall and the Split Rock.
loners.secret: Has found a pass through the ice and seen scimitar cats on the far side. They saw him too.
loners.sampleLine: Have you ever been past the ice? No? Neither has anyone. Except me.
loners.narrativeLeaning: Very easy to befriend (sociability: high). Never a rival (aggression: low). Hard to keep; likes to wander off. Band-eligible only if young adults count (open question).

loners.name: Lichen
loners.appearance: Small thin queen with a grey-green bark-mottled coat, a cloudy left eye, and sabers yellowed with age.

departure.reason: Swept downriver in the Breaking; too frail to cross the marsh home. Mistwood believes she is dead.

loners.attitudeToOrigin: Loves them still. Wants them to know she lived, and to know the truth.
loners.range: The Tar Seeps and the south shore of the Drowned Mere.
loners.secret: She warned Longshadow the ice was rotten. She found Sedge's last cub dead on the shore and buried it.
loners.sampleLine: The ice told me. It always tells you. Most cats don't listen.
loners.narrativeLeaning: Warm and quick to trust (sociability: high). Never a rival (aggression: low). Joins as a non-breeder if past fertile age.

loners.name: Ashfall
loners.appearance: Sooty black tom with smoke-grey rosettes, a white-scarred muzzle, and hollow, tired gold eyes.

departure.reason: Crime: in the hungry season after the Breaking he was caught stealing a goose from the cubs' share. He never denied it.

loners.attitudeToOrigin: Shame. Avoids their land and won't speak their names.
loners.range: The edge of the Ash Hills and the Bear's Throat.
loners.secret: The goose was for his hidden, injured mate Reedsong, who died anyway. Mistwood doesn't know she lived that long.
loners.sampleLine: I did what they said I did. Don't make me into anything better.
loners.narrativeLeaning: Slow to trust, quick to retreat (sociability: low). Not a rival (aggression: medium). Steady once won over.

loners.name: Sedge
loners.appearance: Slender sand-colored queen with reed-thin dark leg stripes, a split lip over one saber, and pale blue-grey eyes.

departure.reason: Grief: lost her mate Rushwater and both cubs in the Breaking and could not bear the old dens.

loners.attitudeToOrigin: Doesn't blame them. Just can't go back.
loners.range: The shore of the Drowned Mere.
loners.secret: Believes one cub lived and was taken by wolves. She is wrong, and Lichen knows.
loners.sampleLine: The river took them. It's going to give something back.
loners.narrativeLeaning: Distant at first, then deeply attached (sociability: medium). Not a rival (aggression: medium). Kindness to cubs matters most to her.

loners.name: Coldwater
loners.appearance: Broad blue-grey tom with a pale belly, a stiff left hind leg, and a long flank scar where the ice opened him.

departure.reason: Stranded on the far bank in the Breaking with a torn leg; by the time he healed, the pride had moved to dens he can't find.

loners.attitudeToOrigin: Wants to go home more than anything.
loners.range: The north shore of the Drowned Mere and the Split Rock.
loners.secret: On the ice he turned back instead of reaching for Longshadow, his father. He thinks his brother's mate Sedge would never forgive him.
loners.sampleLine: If you smell them, any of them, tell me which way.
loners.narrativeLeaning: Easy to befriend (sociability: high). Never a rival (aggression: low). Most likely to rejoin Mistwood by drift, or by a band's mates win.
